sn35.64:1.1: kho āyasmā Migajālo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Migajālo Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu || yam aham dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti || ||
sn35.64:2.1: Santi kho Migajāla cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā || || Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati || tassa tam abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandi || nandisamudayā dukkhasamudayo Migajālāti vadāmi || la ||
sn35.64:3.1: Santi kho Migajāla jivhāviññeyyā rasā || la || || Santi kho Migajāla manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā || || Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati || tassa tam abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandi || nandisamudavā dukkhasamudayo Migājalāti vadāmi || || Santi kho Migajāla cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā || || Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati || tassa tam anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nandi nirujjhati || nandinirodhā dukkhanirodho Migajālāti vadāmi || || Santi kho Migajāla jivhāviññeyyā rasā iṭṭhā kantā || pe || Santi kho Migajāla manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā || || Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati || tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nandi nirujjhati || nandinirodhā dukkhanirodho Migajālāti vadāmīti || ||
sn35.64:4.1: Atha kho āyasmā Migajālo Bhagavato bhāsitam abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi || || Atha kho āyasmā Migajālo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajanti || tad anuttaram brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi || || Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīya nāparam itthattāyāti abbhaññasi || || Aññataro va panāyasmā Migajālo arahataṃ ahosīti ||
